Additionally verified: (i) 15/22 classes with sizes summing to 7!/8! and orders equal to lcm of cycle type; (ii) squaring map C->class(w^2) by explicit permutation representatives (built rep per cycle type, squared, recomputed cycle type) matching committed square_class_index/cycle_type for all 37 classes; (iii) character tables satisfy row orthogonality (rechecked in verifier), column orthogonality sum_lam chi(C)^2=n!/|C|, and hook-length-formula dimensions at identity (two-row dims 1,6,14,14 at S7 and 1,7,20,28,14 at S8); (iv) all 60+110 splitting rows satisfy s,a,g nonnegative integers with s+a=g, and Sym^2/Alt^2 dimension-weighted sums equal d(d+1)/2 and d(d-1)/2 (e.g. S8 [5,3] d=28 gives 406/378); (v) plain-g inner product recomputed from chi^2 without the power map matches committed g per entry; (vi) gap JSON certificates sum exactly to declared totals (10080=2*5040 with sumA=0; 80640=2*40320 with sumA=0) with per-term identities termS=size*chiS*chi_nu, chiS=(chi^2+chi(w^2))/2 verified; (vii) per-shape tallies in DRAFT match CSVs exactly ([4,3]:11/7/4, [5,2]:9/6/4, [6,1]:4/3/1, [7]:1/1/0; [4,4]:7/5/2, [5,3]:14/9/7, [6,2]:10/7/4, [7,1]:4/3/1, [8]:1/1/0) and trivial ([n]->(1,0,1)) and sign ([1^n]->(0,0,0)) spots hold for all 9 two-row lambdas; (viii) gap maximality: S7 unique maximizer ([5,2],[5,2]); S8 three gap-2 ties (([5,3],[4,2,2]),([5,3],[6,2]),([6,2],[6,2])) with lex-first correctly reported as ([5,3],[4,2,2]); (ix) [4,4] S8 row matches Bessenrodt-Bowman Theorem B E4/O4 prediction exactly (5 even/4 odd constituents with s/a=(1,0)/(0,1) respectively). Scope complete: 4 two-row shapes x15 at S7=60 rows, 5x22 at S8=110 rows, all present. Result is finite exact machine-checked computation (proof of the stated finite facts conditional on stdlib integer execution, independently replayed), honestly distinguished from any general theorem; no general formula beyond S7/S8 is claimed.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison against nearest priors. Bessenrodt-Bowman arXiv:2202.03066 is the foundational splitting program: abstract and full text (v3 HTML) confirm symmetric/alternating results are scarce, with closed formulas Thm 7.8 for [k,k], Thm 7.11 for [k+1,k], Thm 7.13 for [k+1,k-1] (introduction explicitly lists S2/A2([k,k]), S2/A2([k+1,k]), S2/A2([k+1,k-1])). These mechanically imply the diff<=2 rows in scope ([4,4] at n=8 verified directly against Thm B E4(8)/O4(8) with exact match; [4,3] at n=7 and [5,3] at n=8 by the admission record's theorem mapping). Hence the [4,4] row alone is not new. However the headline claim is the full 170-triple two-row census with power-map logs plus cross-family maximal |s-a| extremal: rows [5,2] (S7) and [6,2] (S8) have two-row difference >=3, lie outside the [k,k]/[k+1,k]/[k+1,k-1] theorems, and are tabulated here with full (s,a) splitting; no exhaustive certified two-row S7/S8 (s,a) census with committed w->w^2 logs and gap witness appears in Bessenrodt-Bowman (which gives theorems/examples, not this census). Pak-Panova-Vallejo (1304.0738) and Zhao (2309.00764) prove plain-Kronecker positivity (hooks/two-row constituents; square-shape three-row/near-hook families) and cannot imply splitting, which requires chi(w^2) via the squaring map. Internal priors are disjoint: SCOPE017 is staircase rho(4)^2 at n=10 plus global gaps n=8-12, not the two-row-family distribution at S7/S8; SCOPE058/SCOPE006 are plain-g atlases; SCOPE034 is square-fingerprint separation. The S7 gap witness ([5,2],[5,2])=(2,0,2) lies in a BB-uncovered row and is new; the S8 lex-first witness lies in a BB-covered row but the cross-family maximality statement (max |s-a|=2 over the whole two-row family with lex-first tie-break among 3 ties) is itself not stated in BB. Partial overlap on 3 of 9 rows therefore does not collapse originality of the census as a whole plus the extremal synthesis. A timestamp or failed search was not counted; the comparison rests on theorem-by-theorem coverage above.

value.rationale: The headline is a rigorously established exact invariant of a specific natural object that was motivated before computation, satisfying the narrow-datum value standard. Object/invariant: symmetric/alternating splitting pairs (s(lam,nu),a(lam,nu)) for the coherent two-row family of Kronecker squares at S7/S8 with maximal |s-a| extremal. Motivation predates computation: Bessenrodt-Bowman explicitly states symmetric/alternating results are scarce and presents conjectures needing exact small-n (s,a) data, with links to 2-modular decomposition numbers, Catalan combinatorics, and refined Saxl conjecture; the two-row family is the standard Catalan/2-modular-relevant family where those conjectures are stated, and S7/S8 is the smallest window showing nontrivial Sym/Alt divergence while exhaustively certifiable. Not known or mechanically implied: diff>=3 rows [5,2],[6,2] are outside BB closed forms and not implied by plain-g tables (which lack chi(w^2)); verified by replayable class-sum certificates. Future reuse is concrete: citable (s,a,g) test data for splitting-positivity and semigroup/stability arguments, trivial/sign spot-checks, and gap extremals. Small maximal gap (2) is honestly disclosed and does not erase the census value; the claim is a complete census for the stated scope (60+110 rows), not an incomplete survey. Not a textbook restatement (no textbook gives this (s,a) census), not mere parameter substitution, not an unexplained enumeration (every entry carries s+a=g, dimension-sum, orthogonality, and BB spot-check interpretation). Certification polish alone is not counted; the new diff>=3 rows plus extremal carry the value.
